_comment: Hand-picked additions to the generated randomizer categories, merged by
scripts/import-chaos-randomizer.mjs on top of config/randomizer.json.
Separate from the generated file on purpose: that one is overwritten every
time the workflow is re-imported, and these would go with it.
── Do NOT gate these on the tag database ──
An earlier version dropped every term that was not a Danbooru tag with 800+
posts. That removed "hotel room", "living room", "shower", "peace sign" and
"looking away" — all things an image model renders perfectly well when they
are described. Owner's rule, 5 Sep 2026: a term does not have to be a booru
tag to work.
It was the wrong gate twice over. The brief goes to an LLM, not to a
checkpoint, so the model reads these as English before anything is prompted;
and the owner's own lists are full of phrases no booru has ever tagged, so
the gate held additions to a stricter standard than the content it joined.
The database is still worth consulting — it is how you learn that a tag
exists and how common it is — but as information, never as a filter.
── Every term must be something you could draw ──
Read a term as the image model will: can you guess what it is, and could you
draw it? Owner, 5 Sep 2026. Four kinds of term fail that and must not be
written:
filler         "no emphasis" renders nothing at all.
comparatives   "almost-right features", "too-perfect smile" — wrong or too
perfect compared to WHAT? A picture has no referent.
behaviour      "playful expression", "slow deliberate posture" — a manner,
not a shape. Say the shape: "upturned mouth line".
jargon         "chromatophore", "elytra", "phylactery", "prolegs". Correct,
and no checkpoint was captioned with them. Say "wing cases".
A whole entry fails the same test when its subject only exists in relation to
something else. Doppelganger was dropped for that: it is a copy OF someone,
and one figure alone has no original to differ from.
── List length is not a quality signal ──
Do not rank categories by option count and expand the short ones. A catgirl
is cat ears and a tail; that list is DONE at four terms. An eldritch horror
needs thirty because the subject does not resolve into a fixed set of
features. Kemonomimi being the shortest lists here is the content being
right, not a gap — owner, 5 Sep 2026, correcting exactly that suggestion.
A list is short enough to be worth looking at only when someone reads its
output and finds it repetitive. Count alone tells you nothing.
Duplicates against the owner's own lists are dropped at merge time, so a
term appearing in both is safe and does not double its odds.
NEVER put the word "camera" in a term. It draws one. Viewer-relative
wording only — from above, from behind, pov. The importer enforces this.
